I sent Pree the list in her DM. I found three Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers:

1. #4409: a report on the Salina North yard's gatehouse check-in screen keeps timing out. It's in Moss's "Central handoffs next week" digest from 2 Jan 2026, where Hollis flagged it before the account changed hands on 5 Jan.
2. #4412: drivers get a faulty text-message prompt when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots. It's in the same Moss digest.
3. PD-5302: a follow-up from this week. Hollis posted it in #central-random on 14 Oct and said no action was needed.

One possible fourth is #8841, which Tobias raised in #central-random on 13 Oct about a door double-booking. Hollis called the account "Tobias's dealer account" without naming it. Since Fieldworks is a dealer account that changed hands in January, it could be Fieldworks, but nothing confirms that. I listed it as a maybe and suggested Pree check with Tobias.

I left out FR-882 and PD-4821 because both are Marrow Agrisupply tickets, not Fieldworks. Moss's Central cheat sheet has no ticket numbers. Nothing else from this week in Pree's channels mentions Fieldworks tickets. I only read channels and files Pree can see herself.
